name: free-kaggle
summary: Open models first: the free path. Kaggle-served Qwen (alibaba, kaggle/catalog.json) builds through pi. Reviews through omp, the default agent, from three vendors that differ from alibaba: gpt-oss-120b on Groq (GROQ_API_KEY), then Gemini (google, GEMINI_API_KEY), then Gemini through OpenRouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, billed per token, last). It needs no Claude token.
